The '''Scythe of Vitur''' is a two-handed [[slash weapon]] requiring 80 [[Attack]] and 90 [[Strength]] to wield, available as a rare drop from the [[Theatre of Blood]]. The scythe is extremely valuable due to its immense power against most large monsters.

The Scythe of Vitur was once wielded by the [[Gods#Founder of House Vitur|founder]] of House Vitur, a [[vampyre]] now worshipped as a god.{{CiteNews|url=http://services.runescape.com/m=news/the-theatre-of-blood?oldschool=1|title=The Theatre of Blood|newsdate=7 June 2018|quote=Of all of Lady Verzik's possessions, one of the most valuable is the Scythe of Vitur. This legendary weapon was once wielded by the founder of House Vitur, a vampyre now worshipped as a god.}}

Although the Scythe of Vitur has a stab bonus, it does not have a Stab combat style.
